subject: pharmacology
title: Contraceptives, emergency cover and uterotonics

steps.tx: **Combined oral contraceptives** (ethinyl estradiol with progestin: ovulation, mucus and endometrium blocked) are banned by **VTE, migraine with aura, smoking over 35, hypertension and breast cancer** (stroke and MI risk); benefits (ovarian and endometrial cancer down, acne and dysmenorrhoea better, anaemia less) counsel alongside. **Rifampicin and enzyme inducers** (phenytoin, carbamazepine, St John wort) fail pills needing backup; vomiting and diarrhoea re-dose. BP with migraine aura screens every visit.
steps.say: Migraine aura smoker over 35 never gets combined pills: clots kill. Rifampicin fails pills: backup.

steps.tx: **Missed pill rules** (one late: take now; two plus: 7 day backup with emergency cover if unprotected) with **postpartum starts** (combined after 6 weeks breastfeeding, POP earlier) and **post abortion immediate** starts prevent gaps; **transdermal and vaginal rings** bypass gut with same clot cautions. Drug history (antiepileptics, antitubercular, antiretrovirals) with malabsorption (bariatric, IBD) re-routes to LARC. Perfect use beats typical use counselling.
steps.say: Two pills missed need a week backed up plus emergency cover if exposed. Vomiting pill needs redosing.

steps.tx: **Progestin only** (POP minipill strict 3 hour window, **DMPA** 3 monthly with **weight gain and BMD loss** plus delayed fertility, **implant** 3 year LARC, **Mirena IUS** 5 year with menorrhagia cure and ectopic caution) suit breastfeeding, smokers and clot risks; irregular bleeding counsels continuation. Copper IUD (10 year, menorrhagia worsens, emergency best) is hormone free; interaction free LARC (implant, IUS, DMPA, copper) bypasses enzyme inducers. Ectopic risk falls absolutely, rises relatively if failed.
steps.say: Clot risk or smoker contracepts progestin only or copper. DMPA fattens and thins bone delaying fertility.

steps.tx: **Emergency contraception** (**levonorgestrel 72 hours**, **ulipristal 120 hours** (antacids and inducers blunt), **copper IUD 5 days most effective** with ongoing cover) with **medical abortion** (**mifepristone** antiprogestin plus **misoprostol** expelling, bleeding with infection watched, Rh anti-D) and **PPH bundle** (oxytocin, tranexamic within 3 hours per WOMAN, uterine massage, transfusion) complete reproductive prescribing. Ectopic excluded before medical abortion; heavy bleed admits.
steps.say: Five day copper beats all emergency cover and stays years. Mifepristone blocks progesterone, misoprostol expels.
